row: Paul Owens, the Original Dog Whisperer

This is the official YouTube channel for Paul Owens, the Original Dog Whisperer, the non-violent and compassionate puppy and dog training expert for over 40 years and best-selling author of the Original Dog Whisperer & Puppy Whisperer books and DVDs.

Owens teaches only positive, non-force training methods and is nationally recognized as a leading proponent of nonviolent training. Coupling scientifically-proven methods with kindness, respect and compassion, this state-of-the-art training proves that there is no need for jerking, hitting, pinning, shocking or shaking to get reliable behavior.
